accounting_scope.definition: All paths introduced by the Task198 preparation relative to the exact Task197 source commit, including this Step09 artifact set while it is uncommitted.

fixed_point.pass_1: Compute the sorted path inventory from the exact source-to-HEAD diff plus only the declared Step09 files present in the working tree; verify count, prefix, and inventory digest.
fixed_point.pass_2: After the single Step09 commit, recompute the same inventory from the source-to-HEAD diff; require byte-for-byte equality with pass_1 and a clean working tree.
fixed_point.ledger_bytes_are_not_self_certifying: The fixed-point digest covers path names only. The JSON sidecar covers the finalized accounting bytes, avoiding a self-referential content hash.

canonical_boundary: Preparation evidence only; no canonical claim, Foundation, Current, Fire Seeds, R1, MetaRSI, Model-RSI, training, or promotion write is authorized.
